source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-13

procedures.title: Door window glass: remove and install
parts: front and rear glass run channels
steps: (Installation, continued) Set the front and rear channels to the correct in/out position.
Refit the inner and outer window seals, then the door trim panel.

procedures.title: Door window inner molding: remove and install
steps: Take out the window glass assembly (see Window Glass).
Take off the outer and inner window seals.
Reach a screwdriver through the access holes in the inner door panel and remove the 5 screws along the molding face (see figure 33 in the manual).
Lift the molding upward to remove it.
notes: Parts shown in figure 29 in the manual.

procedures.title: Door glass run channels: remove and install
steps: Removal (same for front or rear channel): Take off the door trim assembly.
Take out the window glass assembly.
Remove the screw at the channel's lower end plus the 2 screws holding the channel to the top face of the door inner panel.
Remove the 2 screws holding the stationary horizontal guide channel.
Take the nut off the adjusting stud.
Turn the stud fully clockwise to gain clearance for removal.
Lift the channel out through the upper slot, taking care it clears the opening (see figure 34 in the manual).
Installation: Set the run channel in the door and start its retaining bolts loosely.
notes: Parts identification: figure 23 in the manual (window adjustment points, views A and B).
